description: Representative Nanette Diaz Barragán (CA-44) seeks an experienced Communications Director to lead a fast-paced and highly engaged press operation. Experience with national media contacts both print and digital, as well as with radio/TV bookers and producers is a plus. Salary is commensurate with experience.
